'''Tomo Adachi''' (Japanese: '''足立友''' ''Adachi Tomo'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Adachi was born on April 27, 1980, in {{wp|Ōita, Ōita|Ōita}}, {{wp|Ōita Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She usually provided her voice for a number of anime series, but also occasionally acted in video games. Adachi joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing [[Professor Sycamore]]'s assistant [[Sophie]] for two episodes before being replaced by [[Tomoko Kobashi]].
